metadata.description: Get the most complete WRC Generations experience with the Fully Loaded Edition! The Fully Loaded Edition includes: - Sébastien Loeb's Citroën C4 WRC (2010) - The ""Career Starter Pack"" with 6 extra crew members - 2 Porsche 911 GT3 RS RGT liveries - A pack of 36 stickers for the Livery Editor - Free access to WRC+ for 3 months* Buying this edition before August 31, 2023grants 3 months of free access to WRC + All Live, the official streaming video platform of the FIA World Rally Championship. Visit https://www.wrcthegame.com/ for more details about this offer.
